claims.title: Reciprocal adaptation: backaction, useful-observable retention and gates

quoted_fields.interface: One isothermal bath; overdamped reciprocal purely dissipative coupling; even state parity; constant G positive definite,C,M; no uncounted active/fuel/reversible channel. The write/hold inequality additionally assumes flat free energy, linear observable and the same coefficients during both modes.
quoted_fields.failure: Confinement, barriers, state-dependent coefficients, switching, active fuel and reversible couplings require different analysis. Gaussian endpoint criteria are not continuous pathwise retention or endurance. All numerical values are introduced.
